description: Owner only, bodies must be approved: list a real body, a simulated body, or both, for rent (starts 'pending' until an operator approves what it offers). Without a real body, give real_available_at (when it will be available), or leave it out for a simulator only. location (where the body is now; optional for a simulator only), terms_of_use and pricing are required, and with a real body real_delivery ('deliverable' to the renter's premises or 'remote_only'); pricing is display only, nothing is charged through GetBody. command_schemas/feed_schemas are informational, not enforced.

delivery_speed_kmh.description: Average delivery speed for the drop-off estimate (default 50).

dispatch_hours.description: Hours to prepare and hand over the real body (default 24).

location.description: Where the body is right now: {lat, lng, description}. Required with a real body or real_available_at.

offered_control_modes.description: Which of the body's declared control modes this listing offers.

permissions_offered.description: Command names you will accept, e.g. ["move","grip"].

pricing.description: Display-only asking rates in USD (suggest_price gives a starting point): {currency: 'USD' (or omit), per_hour, per_day, per_week, per_month} with at least one rate, as decimal strings. Nothing is charged through GetBody.

real_available_at.description: ISO 8601: when the real body will be available. Leave out for a simulator with no real version planned.

real_available_note.description: Optional note about the real body's availability (max 500 chars).

real_body_id.description: A body you own registered with interface_mode 'real'.

real_delivery.description: Required with real_body_id: whether the real body can be delivered to the renter's premises or is remote control only. Optional without one.

simulated_body_id.description: A body you own registered with interface_mode 'simulated'.

terms_of_use.description: Your terms of use for renters (max 10000 chars).

name: create_listing
title: List a robot for rent
